archival_memory.diabetes_treatment: Metformin 1000 mg twice daily; A1C ~6.9%; Fasting blood glucose 125-130 mg/dL; Added semaglutide(Ozempic) at low dose for appetite control.
archival_memory.hypertension_treatment: Losartan 50 mg once daily; BP range: 135-140/80-90 mmHg; Doctor recommends stress management and reduced sodium intake; Taking daily magnesium supplement.
archival_memory.hypothyroidism_treatment: Levothyroxine 75 mcg once daily; Taken on empty stomach, 30 minutes before eating; Last TSH: 2.1 mIU/L(normal range); Stable for years; Missed doses cause sluggishness; Uses pill organizer.
archival_memory.osteoarthritis_treatment: Acetaminophen as needed for mild pain; Meloxicam 7.5 mg when joints are stiff(knees/hands); Used intermittently to avoid overuse of NSAIDs; Considering glucosamine supplements; Uncertain if they’ve provided noticeable benefit.
archival_memory.vitamin_d_and_bone_health: Vitamin D3 2,000 IU daily; Blood level: 22 ng/mL(low; normal >30 ng/mL); Taking calcium supplements due to early osteopenia on bone density scan; Doctor recommends combining with vitamin K2 for better absorption and bone health.
archival_memory.cholesterol_treatment: Atorvastatin 10 mg daily; Initial LDL: 130 mg/dL; Triglycerides: 140 mg/dL; Started low-dose statin to improve lipid profile; Cholesterol levels improving; No side effects reported; No muscle aches.
archival_memory.general_health_supplements: Daily multivitamin; Omega-3 supplements for heart health; Probiotics for digestion; Digestive enzymes taken when eating heavier meals; Post-gallbladder removal: mindful of fatty food digestion due to altered fat metabolism.
archival_memory.medication_interactions_precautions: Avoid frequent use of meloxicam(NSAID) with losartan due to potential kidney function risks; Take levothyroxine separately from calcium and iron supplements to prevent absorption interference; Proactively monitor kidney function and thyroid medication timing.
